name: Fairfield by Marriott Cebu Mactan
short_description: Marriott's first city hotel in Mactan, this 196-room Fairfield sits minutes from Cebu's airport and connects directly to Mahi Mall, built for airport-adjacent business and leisure stays.
ai_summary: Fairfield by Marriott Cebu Mactan opened in December 2025 as Marriott's first international city hotel on Mactan Island, a select-service property aimed squarely at 'bleisure' travelers who value proximity and simplicity over resort trappings. Its biggest draw is location: it sits roughly two to five minutes from Mactan-Cebu International Airport within the Mahi Center mixed-use complex, with a direct connection to Mahi Mall for dining and shopping. The 196 rooms come in Standard Twin, Standard Queen and Deluxe Queen categories, with clean, Scandinavian- and Japanese-inspired interiors, ergonomic desks, mini-fridges and smart TVs; some rooms offer Mactan Channel or city views. On-site dining centers on DAVOS, an all-day restaurant serving local seafood and international dishes, backed by The Market grab-and-go and free breakfast for eligible guests. Other facilities include a 24-hour fitness center and roughly 250 square meters of divisible event space, but there is no swimming pool. Early guest feedback praises the friendly staff, spotless rooms and unbeatable airport access, while noting the typical rough edges of a brand-new build, including a lingering new-construction smell and some facilities still being completed. It is a convenient transit and business base rather than a beach resort.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Mactan-Cebu International Airport?
faqs.answer: It is extremely close, roughly two to five minutes by car within the Mahi Center complex in the Mactan Economic Zone. This makes it a strong choice for travelers with early departures, late arrivals or connecting flights who want minimal transfer time and stress.

faqs.question: Does Fairfield by Marriott Cebu Mactan have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: No. It is a select-service city hotel and does not have a swimming pool. On-site facilities focus on a 24-hour fitness center, the DAVOS all-day restaurant, The Market grab-and-go and flexible meeting space rather than resort-style leisure amenities.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the Fairfield in Mandaue City?
faqs.answer: No. This is Fairfield by Marriott Cebu Mactan on Mactan Island near the airport. It is separate from Fairfield by Marriott Cebu Mandaue City on the mainland and from the Sheraton Cebu Mactan Resort. Confirm the exact property name when booking to avoid confusion.
